# Patch catalogue

<!-- Generated by tools/patch_catalog.py from loader/patches.json; do not edit by hand. -->

Every change the loader (`dinput8.dll`) makes to the running game. Nothing is written to the exe
on disk. Addresses are VAs of the analysed exe (image base `0x140000000`, TimeDateStamp
`0x6abf29b6`); the loader rebases them and checks every original byte
before writing anything. If one differs, nothing is applied.

Relocation: `0x258` bytes at RVA `0x9582b0` -> a `0x400` buffer; fields from `+0x248` move by `+0xb0`.

| group | patches | what it does | source | status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| relocate | 78 | Moves the player manager (static at `0x1409582b0`, 0x258 bytes, pointer at `0x140b2ef50`) into a 0x400-byte buffer next to the module, so 4 player slots fit. `rip_reloc` entries repoint instructions at the buffer; `slots_*` raise the slot vector count from 2 to 4; `tail_*` move the fields after the slot array by +0xb0. | FINDINGS 3a, 3b; `tools/scan_player_mgr.py`, `gen_patches.py` | verified in game 2026-10-16 |
| bounds | 121 | Raises `idx < 2` player-index guards to `< 4` (or loops over 2 players to 4). | FINDINGS 3a, 5e; `SlotBounds.java` + `tools/classify_bounds.py`, `IndexChecks.java`, hand review | verified in game 2026-10-16 (the 4 from IndexChecks: 2026-10-17) |
| join | 1 | Lets the join event through while fewer than 4 players are in. | FINDINGS 5a | verified in game 2026-10-16 |
| memory | 1 | Doubles the "System" heap (512 MB to 1 GB) as headroom for 4 players. | FINDINGS 5b | verified in game 2026-10-16 |
| views | 11 | Level setup creates 4 per-player views instead of 2, and the inline view-array guards accept 4. | FINDINGS 5c | verified in game 2026-10-16 |
| quadrants (optional) | 1 | Optional (`enable=quadrants` in `ts3online.ini`): every split request builds 4 quadrants, so each player keeps the same 16:9 quarter for streaming. | FINDINGS 2; PLAN rig design | not tested in game |
| online (optional) | 3 | Optional (enabled by `net=` in `ts3online.ini`): every split request keeps one full-screen viewport for the local player, whatever the player count, so remote players join as partners without a split screen. | FINDINGS 9 | not tested in game |
| instances (optional) | 3 | Optional (`enable=instances`): lets a second copy of the game run on the same PC for host/client play. | FINDINGS 9 | not tested in game |
| hooks | 12 | Jumps or calls into Rust functions in `loader/src/hooks.rs` that replace game code which hardcodes player 1 or only handles players 0/1. | FINDINGS 5a-5f | verified in game (teardown and the controls fix 2026-10-17) except level_player_setup (T8) |

Total: 231 patches.

| VA | change | note |

| `0x14027b6b4` | `e92b090000` -> `e9e9020000` | input driver update (0x14027b500): keyboard unreadable (window unfocused) -> skip to the controller loop instead of returning, so pads (and partners' virtual pads) keep updating without focus |
| `0x14027b910` | `e9cf060000` -> `e98d000000` | input driver update (0x14027b500): mouse unreadable (window unfocused) -> skip to the controller loop instead of returning |
| `0x1405f4718` | `4863f9` -> `31ff90` | SetSplitScreenMode (0x1405f4700): movsxd rdi,ecx -> xor edi,edi; nop, so a networked copy keeps one full-screen viewport (view 0, the local player) whatever the player count |
